dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 13, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers Soar Past Guardians, Reds Edge White Sox in Thrilling Night**

The Detroit Tigers shut out the Cleveland Guardians 3-0 behind Parker Messick's 5.2 innings of work, allowing just 2 earned runs. Chase DeLauter and Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians offense, with Valencia's solo home run the only highlight. Meanwhile, Eugenio Suárez hit a 4-RBI home run to power the Cincinnati Reds past the Chicago White Sox 9-8. Suárez's performance was just one of several big hits on the night, as the Reds' offense came alive to take the win.

In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates dominated the Miami Marlins 13-1, with Rafael Flores Jr. hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs. Braxton Ashcraft pitched 9 shutout innings for the Pirates, striking out 10 Marlins batters. The Seattle Mariners also came out on top, defeating the New York Yankees 1-0 behind Logan Gilbert's 6 shutout innings.
